{{Top}}
The '''Keto family''' was a family of royal blood from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. Many of their members were proficient in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] founded the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], which would later be resurrected by their descendant [[Sebban Keto]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later.
